newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-GERDAU GROUP SHRS STILL ING BUYS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-GERDAU GROUP SHRS STILL ING BUYS.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it has maintained its buy ratings on Gerdau SA and Metalurgica Gerdau SA after the release of the Gerdau group's first-half earnings.

-- ING Barings analyst Mirela Rappaport said in a report said January-June earnings of 65 million reais for steelmaker Gerdau SA were better than expected due to higher equity income and lower interest charges.
-- She also said first-half sales were up 11 percent year-on-year but gross margins of 32 percent were flat despite cost-cutting efforts.

-- Rappaport said costs rose due mostly to a 17-percent hike in pig iron prices between 1996 and first-half 1997. "We expect Gerdau to progressively reduce its consumption of pig iron in favor of scrap and other substitutes," she wrote.

-- She added Gerdau's performance was enhanced by improved equity income from subsidiaries after recent corporate changes and the firm will distrubute dividends worth 11 million reais, or 0.30 reais per 1,000 shares.
-- Metalurgica Gerdau, the holding company, posted net earnings of 69 million reais.
-- "Based on our price price targets, Gerdau has an upside of 20 percent while Metalurgica has an upside of 72 percent," she added.
-- Gerdau preferred was up 0.44 percent at 22.80 reais while Metalurgica preferred rose 2.15 percent at 48 reais at 1158 local/1458 GMT in Sao Paulo.
